meta.source: held-out pieces of the source of fm-wikipedia
meta.notes: 104 pieces in all; atlas took 66; 38 held-out candidates; 38 in this pocket (177879 tokens); NEIGHBOURING PIECES OF THE SAME TEXTS: not independent sources
meta.tokenisation: lowercase NFC word tokens (maximal runs of letters, combining marks and digits; inner apostrophes kept); tokens without a letter dropped; urls, markdown, html and tex math removed (the atlas fm tokeniser)
meta.docDef: pieces of <= ~6000 tokens (equal cuts of long source files at unit boundaries, exactly as the atlas); whole pieces NOT taken by fm-wikipedia, in sha256(id:pieceIndex) order up to 300k tokens; unit = sentence/line as the atlas
